violations.text: Molluscan Shellfish tags did not have all of the required information. Last date of sale were lacking. Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

Raw animal foods (such as fish) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as veggies) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The following was observed: 1) Various foods were observed held at 42-44 degrees Fahrenheit in the walk-in cooler. Person in charge adjusted temperature of the walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. 2) Carrots and cheese were observed at 39-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the prep unit. Foods were observed to be stored over the fill line. Foods were placed in the unit under an hour prior to inspection and moved to refrigeration to cool. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
Establishment observed with TPHC logs for sushi rice up until the end of August. TPHC logs must be kept daily for each batch of rice. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The ice machine in the prep room was observed with pink residue. 2) The fans in the prep areas were observed with dust 3) The shelving at the cookline was observed with an accumulation of grease The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the contamination of food. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2026
